signup_function.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.ensure_athlete_identity_map()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  insert into private.athlete_identity_map (
    auth_user_id,
    creation_source
  )
  values (new.id, 'auth_user_trigger')
  on conflict (auth_user_id) do nothing;
  return new;
end;
$function$
